verdict.rationale: Connecting external accounts is a fair question for an email platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows AgentMail can link Gmail, Microsoft 365, or IMAP accounts. The IMAP/SMTP doc covers the reverse direction (connecting Outlook or Thunderbird to an AgentMail inbox), and org-wide thread listing spans only AgentMail-hosted inboxes. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.
